primary_endpoint: Change in absolute liver fat content: Parts 1 and 2 through Week 12; Part 3 through Week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Liver fat decreased with aldafermin in Part 1 (−9.68% at 3.0 mg; −11.91% at 6.0 mg) and Part 2 (−4.95% to −11.55% across doses); Part 3: −7.70% with 1.0 mg vs −2.73% with placebo (p=0.0018).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 1/27 and 0/28 participants in Part 1, 0/23 to 4/22 across Part 2 aldafermin groups, and 2/53 in the Part 3 aldafermin group; no deaths were reported.
